findings.title: The README table reproduces from the raw reports
findings.text: All 36 cells of the README table (rho S, pair table, inherited-f4, fes-then-inherited, fes-then-batched, ftb/inherited-f4 on six instances) recomputed from results/*.json agree within half a unit of the printed precision and round to the printed figure (36/36; largest relative difference 3.1e-3, a 2-significant-figure rho column). Every row's total_gae is rebuilt from its counts (group adds + doubles at 1 GAE, price_phase's ten native counters at ns_unit/ns_per_add, solver ops at ns_per_op/ns_per_add) to <= 3e-16 relative, and every phase's gae likewise; the four Koblitz reports' ratios equal the docs/ic/calibration.json rows K_0/GF(2^13), K_1/GF(2^17), K_1/GF(2^19), K_1/GF(2^23) to <= 7e-18. ftb/inherited-f4 is a ratio of means, as printed.

findings.title: 'Lowest index-calculus row on five of six' does not hold across the 5a band
findings.text: At each run's calibration point fes-then-batched is below the pair table on five instances (not random 21). Under the band (G - C + w (U + n_C)) / sqrt r the order flips on all six: at w = 0 the solver's word XORs are free and fes-then-batched is far below the pair table (e.g. Koblitz 23: 3.30 vs 3986.1), at w = 0.1 and 1 it is far above (139,358 vs 4,385; 1,393,547 vs 7,978). AGENTS.md 5a: rank only where the order holds at every weight; the pair-table vs fes-then-batched ranking is unresolved on every instance, including random 21 where the README ranks the pair table first.

findings.title: fes-then-batched vs inherited-f4: a tie at w = 0 on five instances and a flip at degree 13
findings.text: Above 14 unknowns both arms make identical decisions (same targets tried, relations, rank and group operations; only solver ops differ), so at w = 0 their S is equal: the strict order does not hold across the band, the weak order (fes-then-batched <= inherited-f4) holds on random 15, Koblitz 17, 19, random 21 and Koblitz 23, with ftb/if4 = 1.000 at w = 0 and 0.816-0.888 at w = 0.1 and 1. At degree 13 fes-f2 tried more targets (mean 50.67 vs 47.33; group GAE 726.3 vs 703.0), so fes-then-batched is ABOVE inherited-f4 at w = 0 (S 16.229 vs 15.708, ratio 1.033) and below at w = 0.1 and 1 (0.701, 0.700): unresolved. The headline 0.74-0.89x is the ratio at the calibration point (word XORs at the pinned or measured ratio), a further point the band never replaces.

findings.title: At degree 13 the two solvers count different units
findings.text: fes-then-batched runs fes-f2 there, whose ops are 'word XORs (Gray-code steps)'; inherited-f4 counts 'word XORs (elimination, specialisation and linear elimination only)'. The repository prices both at one word-XOR ratio, which src/bin/ic/sweep/trial.rs (unit_key) calls right for pricing and wrong for ranking. Diagnostic: with the solver priced by its complete bitop/v1 tally (bitop_word_ops + hash probes + field operations) the order is the same (above at w = 0, below at w = 0.1 and 1) and the w > 0 gap is wider (S(0.1) 13,024 vs 37,566). Above 14 unknowns both arms report the same unit string.

findings.title: Five of the six 'distance remaining' figures are off at their printed precision
findings.text: README line 77-78 quotes S(ftb)/S(rho) as 35.3x, 144x, 306x, 1,903x (Koblitz 13, 17, 19, 23) and 122x, 3,005x (random 15, 21). From the raw reports: 35.24x, 144.72x, 305.45x, 1,907.79x, 121.72x, 3,012.56x (RESULTS.md has the right values). The README figures equal the rounded table S divided by the rounded rho S (35.26, 144.34, 306.37, 1,902.61, 121.71, 3,004.92). The error is at most 0.4% and changes no conclusion; it is outside the headline table, so it is reported here and not in headline.

findings.title: At degree 13 'the lowest algebraic row' is a tie
findings.text: fes-then-batched and fes-then-inherited run the same engine (fes-f2) at 14 unknowns and their rows are identical in every count (validation/recompute.json; control C2 below); the README bolds fes-then-batched alone.

findings.title: Every IC arm stays above the matched rho at every weight
findings.text: On all six instances the pair table, inherited-f4, fes-then-inherited and fes-then-batched are above the matched rho at w = 0, 0.1 and 1 (order holds). At w = 0, the most IC-favourable end, fes-then-batched is 2.96x (Koblitz 19) to 5.61x (Koblitz 13) rho; at w = 0.1 it is 1,288x to 158,790x; at w = 1 12,825x to 1,587,862x. The order also holds against rho charged k = 1 or n + 1 native operations per walk step (sensitivity rho_ext_*).

findings.title: The matched rho emits no unpriced counter (implementation gap)
findings.text: rho_reference.per_run carries planted, seed, s, s_walk, steps, steps_over_expected and verified only: no count of canonicalisations, distinguished-point tests, Frobenius maps or table operations, which AGENTS.md 5a says rho leaves unpriced. In the strict band U_rho = 0 and S_rho(w) = S_rho(0), a lower bound at w > 0. Because rho is below every IC arm at w = 0 and the IC arms only rise with w, the gap cannot change the IC-vs-rho order; a per-step charge (rho_ext_k1, rho_ext_kn1) confirms it. The missing emission should be fixed in ic bench's rho reference.

findings.title: Measured lookup price is 0.0 on the random instances
findings.text: On random 15 and 21 the host-measured ns_per_lookup is 0.0, so lookups and target-guard probes are free at those runs' calibration point (the pinned K_0/GF(2^23) row in docs/ic/calibration.json also has 0.0; it is not used here). Immaterial to S (a few hundred to ten thousand operations per run); the band charges them at w.

findings.title: Provenance of the producer's binary rests on the record, not on the reports
findings.text: Every report has software.git_commit = null and git_dirty = null. The binding of the measuring binary (sha256 1f566eed..., results/ic-sha256.txt, path /tmp/claude-0/.../scratchpad/ic-ftb, still present and hashing to that value) to commit 4900647bcd rests on the benchmark record (commit 4900647bcd, commit_dirty false at 20:09:33Z, binary mtime 20:09, run 20:09:38Z) and on the producer's README. The record's argv does not show IC_BIN. The record lists both raw entries as uploaded: false; the objects are in fact in s3://setec-astronomy-artifacts (store/sha256/15/15dbded3..., store/sha256/fa/fa200ed1...), and results.tar.gz is byte-identical to the committed results/*.json and ic-sha256.txt (its *.log members are byte-identical copies of the JSONs).

findings.title: The bitop/v1 diagnostic tally is not identical between configurations that run the same engine
findings.text: Above 14 unknowns fes-then-inherited and inherited-f4 have identical solver ops, targets and relations, but their bitop_hash_probes and bitop_word_ops differ slightly (Koblitz 17 repeat 1: 3,420,478 vs 3,402,246 probes; 301,031,725 vs 300,859,208 word ops), and this study's fes-then-batched and the batched study's inherited-f4-batched differ by 65 word ops at identical solver ops. src/cryptanalysis/bitop_tally.rs says every count is a deterministic function of the input; the tally appears to depend on in-process state (the order of configurations in one process). The replay, running the same sequence, reproduced every bitop counter exactly. It enters no S here (diagnostic band only).

findings.title: The pre-stated expectation, checked against the sibling studies' committed data
findings.text: Degree 13: fes-then-batched rows are identical to fes-then-inherited's in every count (C2). Koblitz 17, 19, 23 and both random instances: fes-then-batched solver ops equal the batched study's inherited-f4-batched ops run for run (research/inherited_f4_batched_20261112/results_e2e); on the Koblitz instances S agrees to the last float bit (e.g. 84.46324870999565 vs 84.46324870999564), on the random instances S differs only through the host-measured ratio, as the README says. inherited-f4's solver ops equal the batched study's on all six instances.

findings.title: Commit d81dc1241b repeats the unqualified ranking in source
findings.text: The doc comment of DEFAULT_DESCENT_SOLVER (src/cryptanalysis/ic_framework/solvers.rs, added in d81dc1241b) calls fes-then-batched 'the lowest algebraic row on every instance of the 2026-11-12 end-to-end ladder'. That holds at the calibration point; under the band it is a tie at w = 0 on five instances and unresolved at degree 13 (F3).

controls.what: fes-then-inherited = inherited-f4 above 14 unknowns (the size rule dispatches to inherited-f4)
controls.result: identical targets, relations, rank, group ops, native counts, solver calls and solver ops on all 15 repeats of the five instances; only the diagnostic bitop tally differs (F11)

controls.what: fes-then-batched = fes-then-inherited at 14 unknowns (both run fes-f2)
controls.result: identical in every count on all 3 repeats

controls.what: pair table: the reference IC row, priced in the same process
controls.result: priced; its per-step table inserts (setup work_native.table_insert_attempts behind counted:table_insert_attempts) are charged at w per the 2026-11-08 reading

controls.result: 16 runs per walk, all verified; selected walk has the lower mean S (negation at Koblitz 13, 17, 19; signed-Frobenius at 23; negation only on random binary); seeds identical across candidates
